description: This Java class defines mapping strategies for handling different types of policy modification command responses within the Eclipse Ditto project. It maps signal types to specific JSON serialization logic, managing the conversion of various policy-related response objects to JSON format, and provides singleton access to its strategies.

classes.name: PolicyModifyCommandResponseMappingStrategies
classes.description: Defines singleton mapping strategies for converting policy modify command response signals into JSON serializable forms within the Eclipse Ditto project.

methods.name: policyCreated
methods.description: Creates a response indicating a policy has been created, based on adaptable data.

methods.name: policyModified
methods.description: Creates a response indicating a policy has been modified, based on adaptable data.

methods.name: entryCreated
methods.description: Creates a policy entry creation response based on adaptable input.

methods.name: entryModified
methods.description: Creates a policy entry modification response based on adaptable input.

methods.name: resourceCreated
methods.description: Constructs a resource creation response from adaptable data, including parsing the resource from payload.

methods.name: resourceModified
methods.description: Constructs a resource modification response from adaptable data.

methods.name: subjectCreated
methods.description: Constructs a subject creation response from adaptable data.

methods.name: subjectModified
methods.description: Constructs a subject modification response from adaptable data.
